They say that by looking at the past we can predict our future. In this video I give you a crystal ball from our past. To be more specific, a carburettor from our past, that is also a stupid design. It is a stupid design because on it Yamaha, or more precisely a carburettor and fuel and intake systems company called Teikei tried to make a carburettor do something that a carburetor cannot do. 
They tried to make it behave like a small and a big carburettor at the same time. This is very similar to what we’re doing
